name: Granite Switch 4.1 30B (and 8B)

lineage.how_derived: modular bundle: base model plus adapters plus a speech encoder, adapters switched by control tokens

purpose: One endpoint that handles chat responses, decision-making and speech-to-text; adapters are activated on demand through the chat template (coarse-grained expert switching: one adapter active across all layers for a span of tokens).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card links the apache.org text and says the LICENSE file of the granite-switch repo applies; that file read (Apache License 2.0, first lines checked, summarizer). Text matches the apache.org copy.

architecture.kind: dense decoder-only transformer (GQA, RoPE, SwiGLU, RMSNorm) with adapter switching
architecture.why_this_design: Card: a modular LLM that composes a base model, multiple adapters and an encoder so that 'a single hosted endpoint can move between natural-language responses, general and specialized decisions, and speech-to-text'; adapters are activated on demand through control tokens in the chat template (launch blog title: 'Update models like you update software').

engine_support.notes: Official GGUF repos; whether adapter switching works in llama.cpp was not checked.

benchmarks.name: Decision Index (JEV) v0.3, decision adapter: overall / knowledge / language / retrieval / tools

strengths: Enterprise-oriented: German named first among text languages, adapters for guardrail and decisions, Apache-2.0
weaknesses: No general knowledge benchmarks on the card
Checkpoint ships guardian-core and decision adapters only; no RAG adapter
Dense 30B reads all weights per token
best_for: Structured decisions and guardrails in a document workflow
soft.maturity: IBM Granite: steady cadence (4.1, 4.2 30B MLX in September).

tona_fit.reason: A deployment construct (granite-4.1-30b base plus decision and guardian adapters plus speech input), not a stronger model: general quality is that of the Granite 4.1 30B base, for which the card shows no knowledge or German numbers and the independent German index has no entry. Apache-2.0 (text read). Granite 4.2 30B (own record) is the newer dense base.
blockers: no general-use evidence for the 4.1 base

sources.note: model card read in full 2026-11-19: base granite-4.1-30b, adapters decision and guardian-core, embedded 470M speech encoder, revision 4.1.1 dated 2026-10-27

open_questions: General benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA) of the 4.1 base
GGUF sizes and whether llama.cpp handles the adapter/encoder composition (the card lists only Transformers and vLLM)
